name: Network Security
purpose: Enforce TLS 1.3 encryption, certificate pinning, strict socket timeouts, and firewall rules.
inputs: Protocol, endpoint, DNS, certificate, proxy, and service-topology inventory
TLS and mTLS policy, trust roots, allowed destinations, and certificate ownership
Client and server timeout, connection, payload, rate, and availability requirements
outputs: Network transport and exposure audit with protocol and endpoint findings
Corrected TLS, hostname verification, egress, timeout, and connection policies
Handshake, downgrade, DNS-rebinding, exhaustion, and telemetry evidence
stop_conditions: No plaintext, verification-disabled, or unallowlisted production path remains
All clients and servers enforce bounded TLS and resource-exhaustion controls
Token budget exhausted or certificate and ownership authority is unavailable
